CSIR NEERI Project Assistant II Recruitment 2026 - Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the CSIR NEERI Project Assistant-II recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is through a Walk-in Interview, and the interview is scheduled for 14 August 2026. Candidates should be present at the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the eligibility criteria for the Project Assistant-II post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Sc. in Computer Science or a 3 Years Diploma in Engineering / Technology (IT/Computer) from a recognized University.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Project Assistant-II post is 35 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Assistant-II position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 20,000/- plus HRA per month.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Project Assistant-II post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Assistant-II post at CSIR NEERI.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection will be based on a Walk-In-Interview.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the walk-in interview scheduled to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at CSIR National Environmental Engineering Research Institute, Nagpur, Maharashtra, 440020.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies, and recent passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is RECRUIT_SMG_6F_SD_05082026.
